text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif
text.tspan: Expected years of schooling among children by education level
For each year, this shows how many years children starting school then can expect to spend at each education
level if current enrollment patterns stay the same. It includes repeated grades.
